title: Database crash during checkpoint
reason: Engineer matches the broken part and crash problem but cites a filesystem I/O trigger not present in the actual cause.
root_cause: The PostgreSQL container stopped because it encountered a corrupted data block (block 12345 in file base/1262/5.1) during WAL recovery, triggered by a filesystem I/O error or underlying hardware fault that made the filesystem temporarily read‑only.
truth: A data page checksum failure during a checkpoint triggered a PostgreSQL PANIC. Automatic recovery attempted but failed because the corrupted page is in a critical system catalog, leaving the database process exited and unable to start.
